entry.title: Crash Team Racing v0.1.4.1
entry.content:
﻿# CTR Archipelago v0.1.4.1 (pre-release)
> **Pre-release / stability fix.** This build adds crash protections for an in-race crash family reported since v0.1.4 shipped, plus new performance telemetry to help me chase reported stutters. It is marked pre-release because the crash fixes target rare paths that are hard to trigger on demand: the guards are code-reviewed, build-verified, and mirror a retail-verified sibling handler, but the exact averted-crash moments have not all been exercised in-game. If v0.1.4 is working fine for you, staying on it is a reasonable choice. If you have hit an in-race crash or feel stutters, this build is for you.
## Fixed
- Crash when an explosion catches a dropped TNT or Nitro sitting on a crate spot (reported twice within a day of the v0.1.4 release, both on Oxide Station, via the in-client crash reporter). The handler now checks the crate link the same way the game's own sibling handler does. ([#136](https://github.com/dowlle/ctr-native-ap/pull/136), part of the wider guard sweep tracked in [#137](https://github.com/dowlle/ctr-native-ap/issues/137)) - Instance creation during thread-pool exhaustion now fails safely instead of crashing one frame later, and logs an `[AP POOL]` line so reports can tell me it happened. ([#136](https://github.com/dowlle/ctr-native-ap/pull/136))
- Two more guards from the same family: the warped-burst weapon explosion and the spider shadow no longer crash if the instance pool is exhausted at their spawn moment. This exact guard content ran a full online multiplayer evening session without issues before release. ([#139](https://github.com/dowlle/ctr-native-ap/pull/139))
## New: performance telemetry (please send me your stutters)
The client now watches its own frame timing and writes rate-limited `[AP PERF]` lines into `ctr-ap.log` when a frame stalls, attributing the stall to the network layer, the seed verifier, or the game engine itself. This costs nothing in normal play and exists purely so stutter reports become diagnosable.
**If you feel stutters, lag spikes, or short hangs: please tell me.** The most useful report is: your `ctr-ap.log` (or a `support-bundle.bat` archive), roughly when it happened, whether you were online in a multiworld or playing alone, and what was going on at that moment (race start, lots of weapons, a music or track change, connecting). Post in the Discord thread or open a GitHub issue.
Thanks to the players who sent crash bundles. The reporter upgrade from v0.1.4 is what made both crashes symbolizable, so if you crash, please do run `support-bundle.bat` and share the archive.
## Compatibility
- **Client-only release.** The v0.1.4 `ctr.apworld` stays current: keep your existing apworld, YAML, seeds, and saves. The guards are purely additive and change nothing in normal play. - **Windows-only.** Linux users stay on v0.1.4 for now; these fixes ship for Linux in the next full release.
## Checksums
- `ctr-archipelago-v0.1.4.1-windows-x86.zip`: `df09310833cea540119c08d41159d595a4544ae8f5802f1bad7a0fe23c1a7728`

entry.title: Dark Souls Remastered v0.2.0
entry.content:
# **Dark Souls Remastered Apworld & Client v0.2.0** ## The "Drops and Shops" update Note: Logic now uses Rule Builder. **As a result, v0.6.7+ of Archipelago is now a requirement for generating.**
### Version update -> 0.2.0. Both apworld and client have updated. **This release is not expected to be compatible with 0.1.x generated apworlds**.
## New features: * Feature: More guaranteed items! See location changes below. * Feature: New yaml options for shuffling items into the pool added: `boss_soul_shuffle`, `boss_humanity_shuffle`, `boss_bone_shuffle`, `bk_weapon_shuffle`, `lizard_shuffle`. * Feature: Shop shuffle (limited)! Option `limited_shop_item_shuffle` can be enabled to add unmissable merchants' shop locations to the pool. Those whose shops are added are made invulnerable to prevent them being missable. More merchants are planned to be added in the future. * Feature: Shop auto-hinting! Configurable with option `shop_hints`. * Feature: Added `logic_to_access_firelink_altar` (default=Frampt) to let you choose which serpent logic will expect you to use to access it. * Feature: Added `logic_to_access_totg` (default skull lantern), to let players choose either lantern or sunlight maggot, or nothing, as required for TotG logical access. * Feature: Added `start_inventory_from_pool` - to allow players to remove items from the pool when adding them to their start inventory. * Adjustment: Reclassified Humanity drops of 3 or more as "Useful" instead of Filler. * Adjustment: Reclassified Boxes and Sewer Chamber key as "Useful" instead of Progression. * Adjustment: Reclassified Mystery Key as "Filler" instead of Progression.
## Fixes: * Fix: Weight multiplier moved to Difficulty option group, and option groups updated. * Fix: Added some points to help Autotracking of UB/UP in some spots. * Fix: Updated early logic so Progression Balancing should no longer place almost all DSR progression items in extremely early spheres in multiworlds. * Fix: Progressive Multiplier notifications now use regional formatting for percentage formatting * Fix: Added Progressive Multiplier item popups in game. * Fix: Warp to all bonfires should no longer cause a crash in Seamless Co-op.
### Location changes: * Boss drops now are added to the pool. This means you could exclude and spare Sif, with the right options. * Mimic drops now are added to the pool. * Hydra in DB, Undead Dragon in VoD, Sunlight Maggot, Havel, Broken Pendant Golem, PW Fire Surge Zombie, LI Witch of Chaos drops all added to the pool * With all sanities and shuffle options enabled, there are now about 710 checks.

entry.title: Pikmin v0.5
entry.content:
**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/TheLynk/Archipelago/compare/Pikmin_Apworld_V0.3...Pikmin_apworld_V0.5
# Pikmin Archipelago — Changelog
Mod information can be found : https://github.com/TheLynk/Archipelago/blob/PikminV2/worlds/pikmin/docs/en_pikmin1.md Setup Guide : https://github.com/TheLynk/Archipelago/blob/PikminV2/worlds/pikmin/docs/setup_en.md
## v0.5.0 (changes since v0.3)
### New features
**Ship part hint modes.** A new "Ship Part Hint Mode" option replaces the plain in-game part descriptions with Archipelago hints, shown directly on the ship part text in-game: - **Item mode** — shows which item is placed at that ship part location. - **Super Radar mode** — shows where your own ship part is located, and in which player's world. - **Both mode** — shows a single combined text with the item and the location.
**Pikmin bonus items.** The item pool can now include Pikmin bonuses (1 or 5 Pikmin, per color and growth stage: Leaf, Bud, Flower). Every bonus type has its own weight option, so you can shape the pool to taste. Received bonuses are added straight into the matching Onion.
**Pikmin collection locations.** An optional set of checks that trigger as you grow Pikmin of each color. Red, Yellow, and Blue can be toggled independently, each with its own interval so you control how many checks they add.
**Day cycle control.** A new "Day Cycle Mode" option lets you keep the day counter Normal, clamp it to a custom Minimum/Maximum range, or lock it to a Fixed day.
**Full PAL multi-language support.** The randomizer now works in all five PAL languages — English, French, German, Italian, Spanish. The client detects the game's language automatically and shows ship part names, hint labels, and its own status messages in that language, with correct accented characters.
**NTSC-U support.** The USA (NTSC-U) version is now supported alongside PAL: ISO patching, memory detection, language handling, and in-game hints all work on both versions. When you patch, a window lets you choose which version (PAL or NTSC-U) you want to patch, and each version has its own ISO path in `host.yaml`.
**Guided ISO setup.** The first time you patch, the client asks for your clean Pikmin ISO through a native file dialog and remembers the path in `host.yaml`. ISOs are validated by Game ID (PAL `GPIP01` / NTSC-U `GPIE01`), and already- patched or wrong ISOs are rejected with a clear message.
### Improvements
**Clearer ship part location names.** Ship part locations are now prefixed with their area, e.g. `TDS - Bowsprit` instead of `Bowsprit Location` (TIS / TFoH / TFN / TDS / TFT for the five areas).
**Save-aware synchronization.** The client now only sends and receives items while a game is actually loaded. It stays active in a level and on the world map (level select), and pauses on the title screen and the file-select menu, with a short status message shown in the game's language.
**More reliable in-game detection.** Ship part text, displayed part, and language are now read from the game's own data structures (derived from the decompilation project) instead of hardcoded addresses, making detection far more robust and working across both versions.
**Debugging and bug reports.** Debug commands were reorganized and are now English-only: `/debughint`, `/debugdays`, `/debugpbonus`, `/debuglanguage`, `/debugtext`, `/debugsave`. A new `/debugdump` command writes all debug info at once — including the apworld version — as a single block to attach to a bug report. Applied Pikmin bonuses are now listed by item name instead of raw IDs.
### Bug fixes
- **Fixed the stray Python window that opened and crashed during patching.** - **Fixed reconnection.** After losing the server connection, the client could no longer reconnect (`invalid seed_name` error) and had to be restarted. It now reconnects cleanly, and the real seed is tracked correctly. - **Fixed Pikmin bonuses occasionally not being received.** Bonuses could be marked as applied before actually being written to the Onion and were then lost; they are now retried until they land. - **Fixed hints overwriting the wrong text.** Hints no longer replace tutorial text, the intro cutscene, or the ship part *collection* text — they only appear when approaching or inspecting a not-yet-collected part. - **Fixed the file-select menu being treated as a loaded game.** - **Fixed a missing translation.** The "Repair-type Bolt" ship part was not translated in any language. - **Fixed French/German language detection** (the game's internal language order differs from the console's). - **Removed the misleading NTSC warning** now that NTSC-U is supported. - Removed dead code and stale log lines.
### Notes
- Because ship part location names changed, any YAML that excludes or plandos a ship part by its old name (e.g. `Bowsprit Location`) needs to be updated to the new name (e.g. `TDS - Bowsprit`). Location IDs are unchanged, so games already in progress are unaffected. - Requires Archipelago 0.6.7 or newer. - incompatible with previous versions ! ! ! - Update your YAML! ! !

entry.title: Crypt of the NecroDancer v0.7.1
entry.content:
### Mod Requirements - AP Redux Mod Version 3.1.0
### Changes - Add minimum mod version requirement to apworld metadata - Gates connecting to this apworld from an unsupported mod version. Be sure to update your mod and apworld together folks! - Add more varied connection disconnect reasons - Being rejected from connecting to the client due to a version mismatch will specify the mod version required - Add `/goal` command, which is now outputted in the client when connecting to the client from the mod-side - Ex: `Goal progress: Zones (12/24) | Victory condition: Ensemble Mode` - Fix `Progressive Zone Access` keys not propagating the save when connecting to the client - Fix locations being sent when disconnecting from one CotND AP player and reconnecting as a separate CotND AP player in the same session - All player-specific data is deleted now on the client disconnecting from the server. - Change default `zones` goal from 30 zones to 24 zones - 6 characters to complete 4 zones each when Amplified isn't enabled - Clear up unused "Crypt of the NecroDancer" client tab, hide `[CotNDServer]` messages in the client
Please see the [setup file](https://github.com/lastingParadox/Archipelago-CotND/blob/crypt-of-the-necrodancer/worlds/cotnd/docs/setup_en.md) for getting started.
Please inform me of any issues through the associated [Crypt of the NecroDancer channel in the Archipelago Discord](https://discord.com/channels/731205301247803413/1192775219740422176) or through [GitHub Issues](https://github.com/lastingParadox/Archipelago-CotND/issues).
